findings.text: follow-on: test_ratio_selects_its_operator_concept passes at the reviewed base — new-tests-before-fix.log records F.FF, that assertion green at 18b78cd — because a binary name's operator token already reached _ir_tokens before this change, so reverting the change leaves it true; its red in negative-control.log:32 came only by additionally removing the pre-existing binary-operator-token inclusion, a mechanism this change did not add.

follow-on: _operator_token resolves a fused indexed operator to its key by string-prefix stripping operator.op (startswith(f"{key}_")), which the brief told the node not to do and which duplicates model.py:352 _split_fused_indexed_operator, the owner that performs the same longest-prefix split and additionally validates the bound index against the coordinate universe; the addition neither wraps nor extends that owner.

item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/grammar/test_conventions_operator_keys.py; focused-head.log records 4 passed EXIT=0 at 64b5100 and the base arm new-tests-before-fix.log records 3 failed 1 passed EXIT=1 at 18b78cd.
